Chuck Norris was born1wJack GilhamSo glad to know Master Chuck Norris is a Christian. True story: I had the pleasure of meeting Master Norris at the Battle of Atlanta some years back. I was standing in line waiting to get his autograph on a photo I had of him to put up in my Karate school. I was in line behind a young Karate girl that had competed and won her division (still in uniform) as she approached him she ask for his autograph. He said No! (I was thinking really?) He replied not until you give me yours! A big grin came across her face as she gave her autograph to Master Norris. Then he signed his autograph to a booklet she had. Needless too say, it made her day! I was so impressed with how Master Norris handled the interchange with the very young martial artist.
